listing.name: The Warriors (PS2) (Coney)
listing.summary: An incomplete source-only Warriors PS2 reconstruction reaching startup, the frontend and limited levels, rather than complete gameplay. Windows x86-64 uses Visual Studio; Linux/macOS use CMake, with exact host CPUs unconfirmed. Supply your own ISO or mounted disc folder containing WARRIORS.DIR and WARRIORS.WAD. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
